C9000156.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 156 (Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine.; papers: A nine-dimensional counterexample to Borsuk's covering assertion; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/156.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C9000156_MAIN.statement: The rank-one projector set in the trace-one symmetric 4 by 4 matrices cannot be covered by ten subsets of smaller diameter.

C9000156_REDUCTION.statement: A hypothetical ten-set smaller-diameter cover produces a smooth admissible map from RP3 to the nine-simplex.

C9000156_EQUALITY.statement: The manuscript equality-case argument makes the support complex pure with four-label facets whose total chain is a mod-two cycle.

C9000156_COMPLEMENT.statement: An admissible map with the equality-case support complex gives exactly a six-label triangle system on every facet complement.

C9000156_COMB.statement: A four-uniform family on ten labels with even triangle incidence and exact complementary six-label triangle systems is empty.

C9000156_AUX_ENCODING.statement: The auxiliary-free five-gate encoding is faithful, and selecting input clauses preserves satisfaction of the full model.

C9000156_CORE_RUP.statement: The dependency-sliced clause selection has a kernel-checkable RUP derivation of the empty clause.

C9000156_EXTENSION.statement: The sphere-integral extension has exact spectral supports, subspace compatibility, trace-norm preservation, and local smoothness at nonsingular operators.

C9000156_LOCAL_DEGREE.statement: Local invertible smooth fibers of continuous maps from closed manifolds count the total mod-two fundamental class, including disconnected and empty cases.

C9000156_LABEL_BOUND.statement: Admissibility requires at least N_k labels; at equality the matrix sphere map has odd degree and every label pair is an edge.

C9000156_PRODUCT_PARITY.statement: A fiberwise odd map L times S^(h-1) to S^(h+d-1) has even regular fiber count when dim L=d>0 and parity |L| when d=0; the quotient cover class is exactly pr_2^*u.

C9000156_SUPPORT_EQUALITY.statement: For every k>=3 at m=N_k, maximal supports have cardinality k, all regular interior facet fibers are odd, and the sum of facets is the pushforward mod-two cycle.

C9000156_SIX_MAP.statement: The triangles of every admissible RP2 to Delta5 map form an exact six-system, by equality-case edge parity, complementary exclusion, and incidence counting.

C9000156_BRIDGE.statement: A ten-set strict smaller-diameter cover of X_4 produces a nonempty four-uniform family satisfying exactly the retained finite theorem's parity and complementary-six-system hypotheses.

C9000156_SIX.statement: Six-label systems have five-cycle links, nontrivial four-subset restrictions, distinct restricted links, and unique extension from five labels.

C9000156_TRANSPORT.statement: Systems on complements of facets sharing a triangle agree under the exchanging transposition.

C9000156_TWO.statement: Under the finite hypotheses every triangle belongs to exactly two facets.

C9000156_SHORT.statement: Under the finite hypotheses every edge-link component is a three-cycle or four-cycle.

C9000156_BLOCKS.statement: Partners of a fixed facet form invariant disjoint blocks, all omission choices give facets, and every facet meets some block twice.

C9000156_ENCODING.statement: The exact full CNF is satisfiable if and only if a nonempty four-uniform family satisfying the two finite hypotheses exists.

C9000156_RUP.statement: The exact full CNF has a checked reverse-unit-propagation derivation of the empty clause.
